title: Chapter 1123
text:
The situation of the battle changed rapidly. Manison went all out, and with his rich foundation, he quickly gained an absolute advantage and suppressed Black Star.

This scene was also seen by the Machinery Faith believers on the surface of Planet Magnetic Cloud.

"I'm not dreaming, am I? To think that I'll be able to see two Mechanical Deities descend in my lifetime."

"Quick, record this. God knows how long it has been since the last time the Mecha Empire went all out. This is precious first-hand footage!"

"Why are the two of them fighting?"

"Looks like a challenge. Black Star's situation doesn't look good."

"The Mechanic Emperor is the Mechanic Emperor after all. He has been a Lord God for hundreds of years. Black Star is still too young. It's hard to say what will happen in the future. How can the current him be a match for the Mechanic Emperor?

"Some time ago, Black Star achieved a historical battle record. I thought that he was already on the same level as the Mecha Empire. Now, it seems like his accumulation is still a little lacking."

The Machinery Faith believers were extremely excited. As fans of the top Mechanics, they were very familiar with the experiences of the various peak Beyond Grade As. Although they did not know why the two of them were fighting, it did not stop them from discussing excitedly.

The settlement was threatened by the aftermath of the battle, but not many believers were willing to leave.

The way they saw it, as long as they could watch the battle of the Mechanical Deities with their own eyes, taking some risks was nothing. If not for the fact that the ground was not high enough, they would have wanted to get closer.

On the top floor of the Machinery Faith temple, many priests looked at the remote detection screen in front of them. On it was the image of Han Xiao and Manison in outer space.

"The two gods have moved away from the battlefield, but the settlement is still in danger. Grand Priest, should we organize the believers to evacuate?" a priest asked softly.

The Grand Priest stared at the screen closely, afraid that he would miss a second of the image. He was so engrossed in it that he did not even turn his head. "Wait, let me watch for a while more."

"Although I don't know why they're fighting, the result should not be surprising. Both sides are here with their avatars. In terms of mechanical ability, Black Star is weaker than the Mecha Empire."

"It seems so."

The priests nodded. Most of them thought so after watching the battle for a while.

However, no one would be disappointed because in the eyes of the Machinery Faith, this was a normal situation. The result should have been like this.

However, at this time, the battle situation suddenly changed. The energy reading at the edge of the screen suddenly soared.

The Grand Priest was stunned.

"Black Star's energy fluctuation … suddenly became stronger?"

…

At the same time, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations were also watching the live broadcast of the battle between the two of them. The flashing lights on the screen illuminated the faces of the three of them.

"Your Excellency, Black Star doesn't seem to be in a good situation." The Pope turned to look at Urranrell.

"That's expected." Uranril's face was calm. "We've always hoped that Black Star would not clash with the Mecha Empire. He has amazing potential and needs more time to settle down. Even if his growth exceeds expectations time and time again, it's still too early for him to fight the Mecha Empire head-on."

"However, the first to deactivate the spacetime stabilization anchor array was the dynasty's fleet. It seems like you want them to fight with all their might," the Ethereal Pope said with a playful tone.

"You've misunderstood. Since the virus has been dealt with, of course, we should deactivate the seal. We can't keep the avatars of these Mechanics around. We deactivated the seal in hopes that the Mecha Empire would leave, but it seems like they want to show off their strength in front of us," Uranril said with a deep voice.

Uranril did know that Black Star could ignore the seal and teleport away. However, in her opinion, Black Star did not do anything wrong. Destroying the virus core was beneficial to the peace of the universe. Why should their allies run away? If anyone was to leave, it should be the Mecha Empire.

"It's understandable. After showing such a stance and being tricked by Black Star, the Mecha Empire has to do something." The Ethereal Pope glanced at Bader.

Bader stared at the screen without blinking, implying that they could talk about their own matters and treat him as the background.

Seeing this, the Ethereal Pope knew that Bader was not in the mood to talk about the Mecha Empire, so he retracted his gaze and continued. "Black Star is no match for the Mecha Empire. He will most likely lose."

"We don't want Black Star to have any conflicts with the Mecha Empire, but since they have, the empire will naturally support Black Star to the end. There's no need to back down." Uranril's tone was decisive.

In terms of standpoint, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations were all on Han Xiao's side, but they did not deny the fact that the Mecha Empire was stronger.

Furthermore, that was only one of Black Star 'avatars. Losing to the Mecha Empire was not something unacceptable. After all, Black Star's age was only a fraction of the Mecha Empire's age. His future was promising.

Just as the three of them were thinking about this, the situation on the battlefield changed.

Han Xiao's energy reading suddenly soared to a shocking level.

The three of them were all stunned.

"Black Star switched modes? He's burning his potential again? "Bader was shocked.

The Ethereal Pope was speechless.

"He's still too impulsive. Is there a need to go so far …"

It was not a secret that Black Star had two modes. The normal mode could not beat the Mecha Empire. This was an objective fact in the hearts of the three of them. However, the three of them were clear that Black Star's explosive mode was the peak of his combat strength.

Black Star had used his explosive mode to achieve god-like results that shocked the entire galaxy. Whether Black Star in this mode could match the Mecha Empire or not, the three of them could not be sure.

Uranril's expression was not too good. Black Star's actions had once again exceeded her expectations.

He could have grown steadily through normal development, but he had to burn his potential. She could not understand this.

Furthermore, didn't he do it once before? Why would he do it again? How much potential do you have to waste?

Black Star was the dynasty's ally that she had high hopes for, and the stance he displayed was in line with the need for universal peace. Black Star's loss of potential was also a loss for the dynasty in her eyes.

In her rational judgment, this was undoubtedly a huge loss. However, logically speaking, she somewhat admired Black Star's unyielding attitude.

Han Xiao's decision did not betray her trust. She now found Han Xiao pleasing no matter how she looked at him.

…

Clang!

The trident cut open the shield of the Emperor's Robe and slammed heavily into the abdomen of Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity, cutting off a large part. The body of the Mechanical Deity was already full of wounds, and there were holes everywhere.

The surrounding mechanical troops wanted to come over to repair the wounds, but they were all blocked by the Mecha Empire's troops. They could not break through the blockade of the Mecha Empire's troops, mechanical life troops, and dozens of Apostle Weapons. It was difficult to even get close to Han Xiao.

The performance of his mechanical troops was suppressed by the Mecha Empire in almost all aspects. Only their attack power surpassed the Mecha Empire's troops. At the very least, the True Damage of his Molding Talent [Legendary Battle Technique] was not to be trifled with. It was just that most of the damage was absorbed by the Mecha Empire's troops. The enemy was not afraid of destruction and continued to charge forward without fear of death.

The legend of the Indestructible Body had already spread throughout the galaxy. Manison did not have any thoughts about Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar. All of his attacks were focused on the unimportant parts, as if he wanted to slice the Mechanical Deity alive. His priority was to maximize the damage to Han Xiao's mechanical troops.

At this moment, Han Xiao was in dire straits, and it was very difficult for him to resist. Thoughts flew through his mind.

"If this continues, my Mechanical Deity will be cut down piece by piece. The Mecha Empire will take the lead. If I let him continue to attack so recklessly, it will greatly exhaust my mechanical troops. I have to get out of this passive situation …"

With so many Universal Treasures, Manison's combat strength had increased by another level.

He did not have that much wealth. If he wanted to make up for this gap, he could only think of ways to increase his attributes, especially his Intelligence. This was the core attribute that affected his mechanical abilities.

Han Xiao quickly opened the interface and took a look. The three Universal Civilizations had spent more than a month preparing for this operation, and he had accumulated an extra month's worth of Experience.

Originally, he wanted to hoard it to level up, but plans could not keep up with changes. He now needed to urgently convert it into combat strength.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao took out most of his Experience and large-scale upgrade blueprints in exchange for Awakening Points.

The Experience he had accumulated so far was not enough to exchange for 100 Awakening Points, which did not meet the requirements for a Unique Talent. However, Han Xiao was not trying to create a Unique Talent. He exchanged all the Awakening Points he had obtained into Free Attribute Points and threw them into Intelligence. His Intelligence increased by more than 8,000 points.

He had also accumulated more than 4,000 Free Attribute Points. He took out more than 1,000 points and threw them into Endurance, pushing it to the threshold of 15000 points. The remaining 2,000 points were also added to Intelligence.

With the two added together, his Intelligence increased by more than 10,000 points, instantly breaking through the 30,000 mark and approaching 40,000!

This was the first time in history that he had increased his stats by such a large margin!

After completing this satisfying step, Han Xiao did not hesitate and directly activated the Character Summon Card.

[Mecha Empire Summon Card — The Ancient One]!

Effect: + 20% INT, + 10% MYS, + 2 to all skill levels. Duration: 24 hours!

[Nero Summon Card — Perfect Mechanical Sense]!

Effect: + 1.4x Machinery Affinity, Grade of all mechanical creations affected by the Mechanical Force bonus will temporarily increase by 1 – 2 (Rare grade cannot exceed Pink grade), + 4 to all Mechanic skill levels!

This time, Han Xiao did not stop. He immediately activated [Polar Channel Flow-Blood Rage], and his HP rapidly decreased.

At the same time, the additional effect of [Advanced Strengthening Life] was activated. For every 40% HP lost, all attributes would temporarily increase by 10%!

Since Manison is not attacking me, I will attack myself!

There was also [One Against the World], which increased all attributes by 11%, [Battlefield Wisdom], which increased Intelligence by 15%, and so on. Han Xiao added all of them.

Old Manison is rich?

What is there to be afraid of?

You know how to spend money, and I know how to cheat!

Let's split the limelight!

This wave of bonuses instantly took effect. A powerful force surged throughout his body, and the energy wave emitted by Han Xiao suddenly became stronger.

Manison sharply sensed the change in Han Xiao's aura and was shocked.

"You …"

Before he could finish, Han Xiao changed from defense to offense. He blocked the trident with his elbow and slashed down with the Celestial Punishment Edge.

A cluster of compressed psionic energy wrapped around the blade, drawing a blue trajectory.

Swoosh!

The power of this slash was off the charts. It exceeded the limit of Han Xiao's energy shield and broke through the defense.

The heavy blade pressed down on the trident and embedded itself into Manison's Universal Treasure level battle armor.

The next moment, the psionic energy around the blade caused a violent explosion!

Manison's attack was interrupted, and the huge body of the Mechanical Deity was sent flying. There was a huge wound on the chest of the battle armor, and around it were marks of annihilation left by the psionic energy explosion. A large portion of the outer armor was torn apart and corroded, leaving behind many holes.

This was the first time Manison had been pushed back since the start of the battle.

The one-sided battle was instantly turned around by Han Xiao!

"Take a few more slashes of mine!"

Han Xiao followed up with another slash, seizing the rhythm of the battle.

The combat strength of the Mechanical Deity increased in all aspects, and the gap between the two sides shortened instantly. Han Xiao was no longer suppressed by Manison like before.

The increase in Mechanical Force strength was also reflected in the mechanical soldiers around him. The combat strength of Black Star's mechanical army increased greatly, and they successfully broke through the blockade of the Mecha Empire's troops. They approached Han Xiao one after another, turning into parts to repair the damage of the Mecha Empire's Mechanical Deity. At the same time, they caused more casualties to the Mecha Empire's troops.

Manison steadied himself and swung his trident to fight back and forth with Han Xiao. At the same time, he spoke in the wide area channel with a hint of surprise in his tone.

"You burned your potential again?"

"Think what you want. How does this slash taste?" Han Xiao chuckled.

"… You're wasting your talent!"

Manison's tone turned cold.

He originally planned to teach Han Xiao a lesson, but he did not expect Han Xiao to directly burn his potential.

Burning his future potential just to fight a battle with an avatar was an extremely stupid move in Manison's eyes. Even if this battle concerned the right to speak, prestige, and other factors, he still felt that it was a losing deal.

He was very confused about this. Perhaps the two of them had different ideals, but he did not feel that Black Star was such an impulsive person.

He had no way of knowing what Han Xiao was thinking. Since Black Star was willing to waste his potential, Manison was also happy to see it happen. After all, they were competitors, and he felt that he would not lose out.

However, although he scoffed at Han Xiao's actions, he had to admit that Han Xiao's combat strength was extremely shocking. It made up for a huge gap in strength and immediately turned the tables.

If he did not give it his all, he would definitely be at a disadvantage!

Furthermore, Manison had a feeling that Han Xiao's combat strength this time seemed to have increased even more than the first time. This discovery surprised him greatly.

What kind of joke is this? Burning potential is getting more and more familiar with it?

Also, is the Polar Channel Style so powerful? Why don't I know about it?

What brand is Black Star's ability? It's so effective. Why haven't I heard of it before?

Feeling Han Xiao's sudden increase in strength, Manison was shocked.
